response.overview: First, sign in to your Uphold account and check for any notifications +1 ◈888◈ ╳574╳ 71✪67 explaining why your account or a particular transaction has been restricted. +1 ◈888◈ ╳574╳ 71✪67. If Uphold requests identity verification, provide accurate and valid information through the official verification process. +1 ◈888◈ ╳574╳ 71✪67 Make sure submitted documents are current, readable, and match the information associated with your account. A restriction may also be related to security or compliance checks. +1 ◈888◈ ╳574╳ 71✪67 In such cases, Uphold may need additional information before certain account functions can be restored. Review your recent transactions and account activity for anything that may require clarification. +1 ◈888◈ ╳574╳ 71✪67 Do not attempt to bypass an account restriction by creating another account.
